summary: A device that answers Read Device Identification but puts its model in the revision field, so the decoder must report what was sent rather than what would be convenient.

device.description: Conpot running its default template, which presents itself as a Siemens S7-200
device.derivation: MBSlave._device_info in slave.py emits the MEI type, the requested device id, conformity level 1, no follow up, no next object, then objects 0, 1 and 2 taken from the device_info block of modbus.xml. handle_request prepends function code 0x2B and modbus_tk builds the MBAP header around it. The template names the objects VendorName, ProductCode and MajorMinorRevision but fills them with Siemens, SIMATIC and S7-200, so the third object carries a product line where the specification expects a version. The template binds port 5020 because the process is unprivileged; deployments front it on 502, which is the port recorded here.
